lines.speaker: VO
lines.text: Tuesday. Rule one of living in your enemy's house: be out before anyone wakes up. Rule two: his dad wakes up at six.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: Good morning, kitchen! Who wants pancakes? Everybody wants pancakes!

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: Why is he so happy? It's still dark.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Dad, something was in my room last night. It said my name.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: That's just the pipes, champ. This house is a hundred years old. It says all sorts of things.

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: Or it's a ghost.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: Or it's a ghost!

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Not funny. I didn't sleep at all.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: Hang on. I made twelve pancakes. Why are there eleven?

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: Ghost.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Lily, stop saying ghost.

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: Ghost, ghost, ghost, ghost.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: Fine. Ghost, if you're listening, the syrup's in the cupboard.

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: Best. Pancake. Ever.

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: Wow. You look terrible.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: My house is haunted. It knows my name.

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: A ghost? I thought nothing scares you.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: I'm not scared. I'm just very alert.

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: Sure. That's why you hid under your blanket.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: How do you know that?

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: Lucky guess. Everybody does that. Bye!

actions.text: Hard cut: the upstairs hallway before dawn. The attic hatch in the ceiling eases down and Skye climbs down the ladder, backpack on.
The kitchen. Dad, in his apron, flips pancakes and hums. Skye, halfway down the stairs, freezes, then ducks behind the kitchen island. Lily's magnet letters are scattered over the fridge.
Max shuffles in, hair flat on one side. Lily skips in with her teddy.
Skye's hand reaches up over the island and slides one pancake off the stack.
Skye crawls out of the back door with the pancake in her mouth.
Hard cut: the classroom before the bell. Max slumps at his desk. Skye leans on it.
